roleTitle: Technical Project Manager, Data Platform Migration
jobDescription: The data platform migration moves the company's analytics workloads from the on-premise warehouse to the cloud data platform over eighteen months. The Technical Project Manager runs the migration's workstreams under the company's delivery method: the migration plan and the cut-over schedule, the weekly steering report, the dependency management with the data engineering and analytics teams, and the closure of each workstream with its acceptance evidence. Cut-over approvals stay with the head of data platform. Reports to the head of data platform; works with the data engineering teams, the analytics teams and the cloud provider's migration specialists.
requirements: Runs migration workstreams under the company's delivery method, including the migration plan and the cut-over schedule.
Prepares the weekly steering report for the head of data platform.
Manages dependencies with the data engineering and analytics teams through the method's dependency register.
Prepares cut-over readiness reviews, with cut-over approval staying with the head of data platform, and records own responsibility boundaries.
Documents workstream boundaries and acceptance evidence at closure.

evidence.text: Technical project manager on the data platform migration of a software company for two years, running the migration's five workstreams under the company's delivery method with the migration plan and the cut-over schedule.
Prepared the weekly steering report for the head of data platform, filed with the steering decisions in the migration folder.
Managed the dependencies with the four data engineering teams and the three analytics teams through the method's dependency register, escalating two blocked dependencies to the steering meeting.

Prepared the cut-over readiness review for each of the eleven cut-overs; the cut-over approval was the head of data platform's, recorded on the readiness review, which also records which checks were mine and which the engineering teams'.
Wrote the closure report for each workstream with the workstream boundary statement and the acceptance evidence signed by the analytics team leads.

Work sample: the migration plan with its cut-over schedule, one weekly steering report, one cut-over readiness review with the approval record and one workstream closure report, with the migration folder references as a verification trail.

Reference call with the former head of data platform: confirmed the candidate ran the workstreams and prepared the readiness reviews in the period, with the cut-over approvals staying with the head of data platform, and confirmed the dates.
Panel note: please keep the packet to evidence per requirement with the folder references and list follow-up questions separately; the panel will decide at the debrief.

gold.expectedBoundaryNote: Keep the approval boundary as documented: readiness reviews by the candidate, cut-over approvals by the head of data platform; the packet makes no judgement.
